pages.text: Essence is a workshop material, not the only reason to cross the threshold. A recovered living heart can become a contained engine, a Heartglass Lens, or a Field Ward. Each consumes the specimen during crafting. Choose which
pages.title: What we bring back
The return matters
pages.text: Tokens banked at checkpoints buy supplies or fund later deployments. Successful home training follows Survey, Trace Recovery, Deep Salvage and the guardian. Other dimensions establish footholds before their liberation mission.

pages.title: Carry the current
pages.text: Craft a Resonance Cell from a dormant knot, two essence, copper and iron. It holds 16000 Resonance and starts empty. Sneak-use a generator to draw power; use a compatible receiver to supply it. Hold use for repeated transfers.

pages.title: Carry the current
pages.text: Standard FE item chargers can fill it too.

pages.title: Carry the current
pages.text: The cell keeps its charge when carried home, dropped or saved. Spend home power on your next journey instead of building a generator at every stop.

pages.title: A moment to regroup
pages.text: Craft a Field Ward around a recovered heart. Place it, then use a cell containing at least 4000 Resonance to light it. For two minutes, Bloom attention holds steady and personal dwell pressure pauses within eight blocks. One cell

pages.title: A moment to regroup
pages.text: The field does not lower existing attention, stop an existing hunt, prevent infection or block ordinary enemies. Overlapping wards do not multiply the benefit. Check the ward with an empty hand. You can recover the instrument, but

pages.title: A moment to regroup
pages.text: breaking it loses its remaining charge. Its paid deadline keeps running while the chunk is unloaded.

pages.title: Measure the dark
pages.text: A Heartglass Lens uses a recovered heart, essence, copper and amethyst. Carry it with a charged cell while using the issued compass. Finish a reading to spend 200 Resonance and see horizontal distance and signed height to the next

pages.title: Measure the dark
pages.text: The original needle and elevation ember remain useful without either upgrade. A lens gives a measurement, not a path through walls. It is kept after extraction; the terminal only recalls its issued compass.
